source.verification: actual source bytes read by this exporter

canonical_json_definition: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, UTF-8

geometry.association: only geometry in actual dataset component

circle.source: live Circle feature pos/r and geometry lengthUnit

mask_semantics.cylinder_mask: r <= R + 1e-12 m, includes the cylinder boundary
mask_semantics.invalid_mask: any raw u/v/p value non-finite at this time and coordinate
mask_semantics.mask: union of cylinder_mask and invalid_mask; masked values stored as NaN; non-finite fluid values reject export
